column1: # subfamilies.tsv - v1. Reconciled against observed_names.txt (T2T-style RepeatMasker run).
# repeat_name = exact RepeatMasker name (join key). Names not listed here default to tier=old.
# tier: active | young | intermediate | old | internal | generic
#   internal = internal region of a multi-part element (e.g. HERVK-int); carries no age itself, age comes from its LTRs.
#   generic  = belongs to a mobile-element group but the name gives no subfamily/age evidence; judge by divergence only.
# rm_family = expected class/family string in col 11 of the .out (cross-check; flag mismatches).
# max_div = optional per-subfamily override of the tier default (empty = use default).
# "not observed" in notes = absent from the first dataset; kept because other libraries (hg38, other Dfam releases) may use it.
